method: Direct view_image inspection of every original guide, all raw generation pages, all eight source/candidate pose comparison pages, every source-ordered helper group contact, and all both-facing decoded GIF/frame contacts. Native-scale and enlarged static review. No continuous playback.

poses.observations: Walk entry: four horse legs separate from rider boot; forward near foreleg and saber across chest visible; full tail and hooves.
Walk second: foreleg lowers while opposite leg folds; helmet and low saber remain attached; no edge loss.
Walk third: far foreleg folds upward while near foreleg extends; rump and plume stay coherent.
Walk fourth: foreleg reaches right with rear legs gathered; no added hoof or duplicated rider limb.
Walk fifth: planted near foreleg and diagonal rear step readable in both facings.
Walk sixth: raised far foreleg and trailing hindleg differ from idle; weapon stays near waist.
Walk seventh: tucked foreleg and opposite extended foreleg visible; horns and tail retained.
Walk eighth: forward hoof extends, rider boot remains distinct; endpoint returns to first gait silhouette.
Repaired gesture entry: shallow low saber across horse chest replaces excessive downward droop; four standing legs retained.
Gesture second: saber lifts near horizontal and horse head tilts toward viewer; grip visible.
Gesture third: bent sword arm crosses helmet and blade extends up-right; full tip and plume.
Gesture apex: sword raised above helmet with horse head toward viewer; identical apex holds remain source repeats.
Newly drawn neutral original idle: low diagonal curved blade, closed red-slit helm and complete mount; no master reuse.
Idle breathing second: subtle head/armor change while planted legs and low saber remain coherent.
Idle breathing third: distinct drawn breathing pose; horse proportions and red fringe stable at native-scale review.
Idle breathing fourth: low curved blade remains attached; no anatomy or alpha break in return sequence.
Idle breathing apex: upright rider and planted horse, distinct source ID; materials vary mildly across generation pages.
Repaired hurt entry: free arm horizontal, plume thrown left and horse head dipped; low saber now visibly retained across neck.
Hurt recoil: rider arches backward with free arm up; saber tall to left; horse forelegs buckle.
Hurt apex: deeper lowered horse neck and backward rider; upright curved blade and complete rear legs.
Hurt return: rider brings saber diagonally up in front of face; horse still bent; no clipping.
Hurt recovery: rider comes upright and blade lowers across chest; hoof and plume silhouettes complete.
Hurt exit: lower chest-level saber and settling mount distinguish exit from recoil.
Guard entry: saber near horizontal at horse neck; complete mount and rider leg separation.
Guard lift: saber diagonal up-right with bent elbow; blade connected to hand and horse legs distinct.
Guard higher: steeper raised blade and slightly bowed horse head; no extra weapon.
Guard apex: high nearly horizontal blade near face; source five-position hold and reverse return retained.
Death recoil: rider leans backward with free fist high and saber to left; buckling horse remains complete.
Death rear begins: horse lifts forelegs while rider leans back with both arms raised; black plume retained.
Death rear apex: raised neck and folded forelegs, rider leans back; four horse legs coherent.
Repaired death roll: horse remains airborne with broad flank and legs extending down-left/down-right; saber overhead and rider twisted.
Repaired next death roll: flank faces viewer, horse feet remain below body, rider falls backward with arms high; final heap occurs later.
Final death: low horizontal horse on side, folded legs and partially obscured rider boots/helmet; no standing substitution.
Turn first: three-quarter right horse/rider, saber near face; silhouette begins narrowing.
Turn middle: horse muzzle and rider rotate toward viewer; narrower flank and foreshortened far legs.
Turn endpoint: near-frontal narrow horse/rider with upright saber; no repeated profile; mirror keeps foreshortening.
Melee start shared by three attacks: bowed horse neck and saber low diagonally forward; shared pose file preserved.
Melee draw back: saber points up-left and horse lifts foreleg; hand/blade connected.
Melee rear: horse chest rises, forelegs raised; rider leans back with saber to left; distinct from standing idle.
Upper melee apex: saber overhead toward left while horse foreleg reaches right; full sword, horn and hoof margins.
Upper melee forward action: rider leans across raised horse neck, saber steep up-right; trailing boot separate from hindlegs.
Repaired upper return: rider back and plume face viewer, eye slit concealed, horse head dips; saber tip visible above plume.
Upper recovery: saber steep up-right before helmet, torso returns upright; hoof silhouette complete.
Upper exit: forward near-horizontal saber above horse head and extended arm; no tip clipping.
Front melee apex: raised saber over helmet toward left, horse foreleg kicks right; complete equipment.
Front slash: rider leans forward, saber extends horizontally at horse muzzle; full curved tip.
Front follow-through: torso bent, saber falls down near horse chest; no extra arm/leg.
Front recovery: low diagonal sword by horse chest; horse stance settling.
Front exit: upright rider and low diagonal curved saber; complete source position retained.
Lower melee apex: sword over helmet points left, raised horse foreleg forward; matches source action silhouette.
Lower slash: rider bends far over lowered horse neck, blade directed down-right; plume trailing left.
Lower follow-through: downward saber near foreleg, rider bends forward; four horse legs remain distinct.
Lower recovery: saber low beside rider leg and horse head lowered; no idle substitution.
Lower exit: saber diagonal down-right and rider returns upright; full hooves.
Special entry: native red saber effect follows low chest blade; red illumination stays attached to mount/rider.
Repaired special lift: red saber vertical before helmet and free fist extended horizontally right; source weapon effect retained.
Special higher: red saber steep upward in front of rider, hand/arm connected; full lit blade within frame.
Special apex: red saber overhead with free arm extended and horse head bowed; repeated holds and reverse retained.
Movement start first: low curved saber with foreleg starting to lift, full tail and hooves.
Movement start second: saber near horizontal, different walking leg placement; no reused idle bitmap.
Movement stop first: horizontal chest-level blade, forward horse step; both facings clear.
Movement stop second: lower blade and settling legs, endpoint remains complete and follows source order.

Four gesture poses raise sword from shallow waist plane to overhead; p011 repeats five times and reverse return retained; repaired p008 viewed.
Five distinct breathing drawings with exact source return 15,14,13; no substituted motion; mild generated material variation remains.
Hurt progresses arm throw, backward arch, bowed neck and recovery; repaired p017 appears at shared entry; blade and hoof bounds intact.
Guard raises blade through four poses, five-position p026 hold and reverse return; source and mirror retain visible grip.
Shared hurt entry leads into rear, airborne flank rotation and low final corpse; repaired p030/p031 keep feet below body until final fall; no clipped parts.
Turn narrows from right three-quarter through foreshortening to near frontal; upright saber retained.
Exact reversed turn 35,34,33 inspected; no reordered frames.
Legacy alias of G7 inspected separately; same three forward turn poses in exact order.
Legacy alias of G8 inspected separately; exact reversed three-pose sequence.
Shared windup to upper action and return; repaired away-facing rider in p041 retained; sword and horse neck change in source order.
Shared windup then overhead front slash, horizontal reach and downward follow-through; complete blade/hooves in both facings.
Shared windup then overhead to low-target slash and vertical/downward recovery; downward sword and bowed neck distinguish lower attack.
Four red-weapon poses, p057 five-position hold and reverse; repaired extended free arm p055; effect remains native embedded weapon light.
Exact special alias of G17 inspected separately, same red blade poses, holds and reverse, both facings.
Exact special alias of G17 inspected separately, same sequence and stable repeated apex, both facings.
Two start poses inspected with distinct leg setup and low-to-horizontal saber.
Two end poses inspected with horizontal-to-low saber and settling legs.

nonblocking_limits: Small strap, rivet, plume and steel-highlight variations remain between independently generated drawings.
Static frame transitions were inspected; continuous playback smoothness and original timing were not verified.
